description.en: Registers a handle (map, camera, or character) with the HQ event system initialized by CMND_HQ_EVENT_INIT, tagged with a role/type index (0 for the map, 1 for the camera, 2 for characters/props in the shipped scripts).
Role/type tag for the handle (0 = map, 1 = camera, 2 = character/prop).
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).
